newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA NICKEL, COPPER, TIN DOWN ON WORLD TRENDS.
newsitem.headline: INDIA NICKEL, COPPER, TIN DOWN ON WORLD TRENDS.

text.p: Copper, tin and nickel prices extended losses on the local market on Wednesday, dealers said.
Other base metals were steady in a narrow price band.
Copper, tin and nickel dropped further on the back of losses in the world market while demand from local industrial consumers remained at low ebb.

Copper fell 50 rupees at 13,100 rupees per quintal. Tin moved down by 200 rupees at 28,700 rupees per quintal after losing 100 rupees on Tuesday while nickel prices crashed further by 400 rupees at 33,100 rupees per quintal after losing 300 rupees on Tuesday.

Aluminium was quiet at 7,800 rupees per quintal as was zinc at 8,400 rupees and lead at 4,200 rupees per quintal in nominal trade. Overall volume remained low as major players waited for domestic producers to announce sale prices for the second half of the current month.
